subject: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC / air-gap requirements
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC / air-gap requirements

Hi John (and Priya),

Thanks for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have aligned expectations. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of pain points and drivers
- PHI/data residency: AcmeHealth needs all patient data to remain in your VPC/region with no egress to shared tenants.
- Air-gap/controlled update process: For the 3 regulated environments you mentioned, updates need to be staged and applied via out-of-band rollout (no direct external pull).
- Networking constraints: Strict outbound egress rules, limited NAT, and only certain IP ranges allowed for management.
- Audit & key management: Customer-managed encryption keys (KMS/HSM) and detailed audit logs are required for compliance.

Goals we discussed
- Private VPC deployment in AWS us-east-1 with customer-managed VPC peering or Transit Gateway
- Support for offline/air-gapped update flow and attestable update process
- SOC 2 / security questionnaire answers and a short reference for a similar healthcare deployment

Technical notes / constraints
- Our Private offering supports VPC-only control planes and on-prem air-gapped installs; Marissa (cc'd) will own the technical deep-dive.
- We will need your network diagram and list of allowed egress IPs for the bastion/management plane.
- For air-gapped sites, we use an image bundle + signed artifacts that you can host; we’ll provide instructions for the offline update process.

Next steps (owner + ETA)
1) AcmeHealth: share network diagram & list of required IP ranges / firewall rules by EOD 8/25 (John/Priya)
2) Redwood: provide detailed Private/VPC architecture doc, air-gap update process, and SOC 2 extract by 8/22 (Camila) — attached overview + networking checklist
3) Schedule 60-min technical deep-dive w/ Marissa for 8/27–8/29 (Camila/Marissa to propose slots)
4) Procurement: draft MSA and SOW template for initial PoC (Camila)

Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-overview.pdf, networking-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
